fields.options: Notify delivers desktop pop-ups and mobile lock-screen alerts for your bell notifications, powered by your own free Firebase (Google) project. Complete the sections below once; all credentials stay on this site and are never shared. New here? Follow the 5-minute setup guide in the app README.

fields.description: Master switch. When off, no desktop or mobile notifications are sent.
fields.label: Enable Notify

fields.description: An internal label for this integration. Leave the default unless a Notify specialist advises otherwise.
fields.label: Project Name

fields.options: These five values identify your Firebase web app in the browser. Copy them from Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Your apps (Web app) → SDK setup and configuration → Config. Tip: click Paste firebaseConfig at the top of this page to paste the whole snippet and fill every field automatically. These are public identifiers, not secrets.

fields.description: Your Firebase web app key (the "apiKey" value). Identifies the project; not a password.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: The "projectId" value — your Firebase project's unique ID.
fields.label: Project ID

fields.description: The "messagingSenderId" value — the numeric ID of your Cloud Messaging sender.
fields.label: Messaging Sender ID

fields.description: The Web Push public key that lets browsers subscribe. Generate it in Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging → Web configuration → Web Push certificates → Generate key pair, then paste the key here.
fields.label: VAPID Public Key

fields.options: This is the private key your server uses to send notifications to Firebase. In Firebase Console → Project Settings → Service accounts, click Generate new private key to download a JSON file, then paste its full contents below. Keep this secret — it is stored only on this site and never sent anywhere else.

fields.description: Paste the complete contents of the service-account JSON file (starts with { "type": "service_account", ... }).
fields.label: Service Account JSON

fields.description: Send notifications to employees' phones through the Frappe HR (ESS) mobile app. Requires the Frappe HR app to be installed and the site to be reachable over HTTPS.
fields.label: Enable Mobile / ESS Push

fields.description: The public https:// address employees use to open the HR app (for example https://hr.yourcompany.com). Leave blank to detect it automatically.
fields.label: Public Site URL

fields.description: On: send a notification for everything that appears in the bell (mentions, assignments, approvals, workflow updates). Off: send only the events you define under Notify Rule.
fields.label: Push All Bell Notifications

fields.description: Play a sound with the desktop pop-up.
fields.label: Play Sound

fields.description: Upload your own alert sound (MP3 or WAV, ideally under 2 seconds). Plays with the desktop pop-up. Leave empty to use the built-in chime. (Background and mobile alerts use the device's own notification sound.)
fields.label: Custom Sound

fields.description: An image shown on the notification when the source item has no icon of its own (for example your company logo).
fields.label: Default Icon

fields.description: Pause desktop and mobile alerts during the time window below (for example overnight). The in-app bell still updates as normal.
fields.label: Respect Quiet Hours

fields.description: Automatically forget a device if it hasn't connected for this many days (keeps the device list tidy). A daily background job handles the cleanup.
fields.label: Remove Inactive Devices After (days)
